For nonconstant r, the degree argument forces 2+r'=0, yielding p(x)=-x+c, while constant r yields p(x)=x+c. The sufficiency checks provide valid polynomial choices of q in every case. The statement is self-contained, no external or internal references require validation, and no hard prohibition is triggered.
